rationale: Reuses the existing 1:1 StepKind-to-state routing and last_done() fact-feedback precedents, calls the shipped ENH-3632 advise-consult helper as-is, keeps decide()/after_go_no_go() free of I/O, and mirrors the ENH-3633 sibling design instead of forking a second integration shape.
rule: Option A — new StepKind returned by after_go_no_go(), consult runs as a loop state
alternatives_rejected: Option B (in-process consult_for_trigger call inside after_go_no_go) — would introduce the first I/O/subprocess call into the pure _Decider layer, duplicate ~180 lines of advise_consult.py's persistence/replay logic, and diverge from the ENH-3633 precedent.
